About

contract Researcher {
  string role = "Blockchain Security Researcher";
  string base = "UIT, VNU-HCM - Ho Chi Minh City";
  uint16 born = 2005;
}

I am Huynh Phan Gia Bao, an Information Security undergraduate researcher at the University of Information Technology (UIT), VNU-HCM. I study how independent blockchains can interoperate without handing trust to a single bridge, relay or operator.

My work combines zero-knowledge proofs, market-based relaying and formal verification to fix concrete weaknesses in cross-chain systems, and extends to decentralized identity and reputation: soulbound credentials, reputation-weighted consensus and evidence-driven trust.

  • Cross-Chain Interoperability

    Trust-minimized bridges, multi-relay markets, unlinkable swaps.

  • Zero-Knowledge Proofs

    Private verification across consortium and public chains.

  • Smart Contract Security

    Finding and formally ruling out exploitable bugs.

  • Identity & Reputation

    Soulbound credentials and evidence-driven trust.
